text: DENSO Corporation is listed on the Tokyo and Nagoya stock exchanges. Its principal shareholders as of 31 March 2025 were Toyota Motor Corporation with 21.25% of voting rights, The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account) with 13.20%, Toyota Industries Corporation with 5.59%, Custody Bank of Japan (trust account) with 5.00% and Toyota Fudosan with 4.72%.
short: Denso is listed in Tokyo/Nagoya; top holders are Toyota Motor (21.25%) and trust banks.
